speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment among current ongoing constructions projects (a) how many have been granted permission to work on weekends; and (b) whether there has been an increase of constructions projects granted permission to work on weekends as compared to the last tightening of COVID-19 pandemic restrictions.

speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
text: Will the Ministry consider: one, tighter enforcement on noise management for construction activities on Sundays and public holidays; and two, reducing the hours on Sundays and public holidays for construction if the construction sites are sited near residential areas.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: On the first one, NEA has been stepping up on enforcement.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: The second point about reducing hours, it is something that we constantly try to strike a balance for, between creating a more conducive environment and ensuring that the projects, construction works, progress within certain timeframes and with certain costs.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: This will have an impact not just on the duration of the work, which will ultimately cause more disamenities and prolonged noise for our residents.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: So, on this part we will try to strike a balance.

speaker: Mr Desmond Tan
text: The current regulation and guidelines in place would be effective to try and reduce and balance the need for construction to progress within certain time and costs, and the noise disamenities that is caused for our residents.
